why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Jazz Chisholm Jr. is slot #3 (4.805 expected team runs/game).
Slots #3, #5, #4, #6, #2, #1, #7, #8 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #6 ranks 4 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.003 R/G.
Slot #3 yields 4.49 expected PA/game vs 4.17 at primary slot #6. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
